title: PARKED -- Utilz: install beside the product dispatcher
objective:
**PARKED by hv, 2026-08-10: the beside-the-product shape needs more thought before devbin enters Utilz. Nothing below executes until hv reopens it; it stands as the survey record.**

Install devbin into Utilz (`~/Devel/prj/Utilz`, shell) BESIDE its product: `bin/` holds fourteen shipped tools and their `utilz` dispatcher, which devbin does not replace, rename, or touch. Devbin enters as dev tooling only. First question of the WP: prove what `devbin install` does when `bin/utilz` already exists and is not a devbin symlink -- refuse-or-skip is right, a clobber is a base defect to file before proceeding.
body:
